description: 40 mm cube with an 8 mm × 8 mm pocket 32 mm deep (depth/width = 4.0). On a coarse cascadio mesh the cavity-depth detector currently misses this — fixture is kept as a regression target for the adaptive-tessellation work in Stage 3 / B-rep cavity detection in Stage 5.
